brief.briefing:
Risk this week
Elevated and well above normal for this time of year. About 28% chance of flash drought starting this week, compared to 4% normally — about 7.1 times normal. About 44% chance in the next 28 days vs 13% normally. Most weeks with elevated risk do not end in flash drought, but stay alert.

Why
Topsoil is okay now. Root-zone moisture near 64th percentile, 0% of local area already in drought, Drought Monitor shows none. Deeper soil is drier, near 37th percentile. Forecast drives risk: rainfall well below normal over the next couple weeks, temperature above normal, air dryness far above normal. 83% of forecast scenarios show a hot, dry spell. You sit among the highest-risk blocks in the region.

What to watch
Rain totals this week and next, heat and drying winds, and how fast surface moisture drops.

Suggested actions
Check soil moisture often, delay non-essential tillage, have irrigation ready if you have it, and avoid stressing young crops. Review feed and water plans.

ask.q: Do I need to start my pivot today?
ask.answer:
Yes, start today.

Your root zone is 52% full and you have about 1 day until stress if no rain. It would take about 13 days of full-time pumping to fill it, needing about 3 inches.

Flash drought chance in the next 7 days is 16%, about 5 times the normal 3% for this time of year, so risk is high but not certain.

Starting today is worth about $9 per acre. If you wait for the next forecast in 2 days, that decision is worth about $6 per acre.

ask.q: I put an inch on yesterday. Do I still need to start?
ask.answer:
Yes. I logged your inch from yesterday.

Root zone is 66% full, still 2.02 inches short, about 4.1 days until stress if no rain.

Flash drought chance is 16% in the next 7 days, about 5.4 times normal.

Advice is still start the pivot today. Worth about $9 per acre to start today, versus about $6 if you wait for the next forecast in 2 days.

ask.q: What's the chance of a flash drought in the next two weeks, and is that unusual for this time of year?
ask.answer:
Chance in the coming days is 16%. Normal for this time of year is 3%, so this is 5.4 times normal - yes, unusual.

Chance in the following stretch is 6%.

Root zone is 52% full, about 1.4 days until stress if no rain, soil at 32nd percentile. Next forecast in 2 days and that forecast is uncertain.
